panel_description_zh: 极特写平视正面，李斌脸部从额头到下巴，半张脸陷在白色枕头里；眼睛完全闭合（眼睑微紧），黑眼圈清晰，内眉上挑形成疲惫蹙眉，嘴唇压成一条细线，下巴略收向胸口约 10-15 度；一只手臂横搭在额头；被子边缘露出一点海军蓝；晨光从画面左上方斜入打在右半脸，左半脸陷在阴影里；光柱里有极淡的灰尘微粒。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.tail_pointing: 画面外的门口方向（妻子不在画面内）

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions, muted warm-cool palette. Eye-level extreme close-up of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man's face from forehead to chin, half-buried in a white pillow. Eyes fully closed, eyelids slightly tensed (not relaxed sleep), lashes visible against dark circles, slight twitch at outer corners. Eyebrows: inner ends pulled up and pinched together — pained-tired furrow, not angry furrow. Mouth: lips pressed together in a thin line, corners neither smiling nor frowning, just held. Jaw subtly clenched, two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible. Head tilted slightly downward, chin tucked toward chest by 10-15 degrees. Short black slightly messy side-swept hair. One arm thrown over the forehead, the loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt collar slightly stretched at the neckline. White pillow, navy blue duvet edge visible at the bottom. Harsh morning sun slicing from upper left through a curtain gap onto one cheek only, the other half of the face in deep shadow, faint dust particles visible in the light beam. Cool blue-grey ambient bedroom shadow. Quiet, exhausted, suffocating mood. Text watermark 'P01-PN06' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: open or half-open eyes, any smile, tears (this is exhaustion not sadness), exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, anime proportions, bright flat lighting, wife visible in frame, soft romantic mood, sunrise colors
